svg.text: Later rooms (phase C), each tuned by the ladder's model
In every room the named habit fails and the idea wins; every hand holds the tempting wrong card
dominoes fall in the joining word's order
all three cards say the same sound
a phrase sticks to the noun beside it
The dragon is small and the dragon is
green and it sleeps … (falls off the end)
three things, eight slots: weave them
The ball was chased by the dog.
the subject stands in the light
the first noun is the doer: 0 %
